{{Top|leg}}
A '''Labyrinth Complex''' was a type of [[Complex]] [[Fence (swoopchasing)|Fence]] obstacle used in [[swoopchasing]]. Labyrinth Complexes involved multiple paths and tested a rider's analytical skills and nerves as they navigated turns and dead-ends. [[The Channel (swoopchasing)|The Channel]] was a Labyrinth Complex.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
